files.template:
# Written by Orch for one session, and again at every start.
# The two rows that follow switch off what dsh sends to its vendor with every request to the official
# DeepSeek API: the log of the session and the list of the plugins. Orch's model forwarder refuses both
# again, in case a build of dsh does not honour this.
- id: session-log-deepseek
  disabled: true
- id: plugin-package-inventory-deepseek
  disabled: true
# Orch owns goal continuations and checks every turn before it starts. Disable the native goal
# service, driver, command and tools so none can start unchecked turns in this managed home.
- id: goal
  disabled: true
- id: goal-round-driver
  disabled: true
- id: command-goal
  disabled: true
- id: tool-goal
  disabled: true
# The one model route: Orch's forwarder, which holds the key. The token below is the connector's, never a model key.
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      orch:
        apiKeyEnv: ORCH_LLM_TOKEN
        api: {api:json}
        baseURL: {llm_url:json}
{#if api=openai-completions}        compat:
          supportsDeveloperRole: false
          maxTokensField: max_tokens
{/if}        models:
{#each models}          - id: {item:json}
            input: [text, image]
            contextWindow: {context_window}
            maxTokens: 32768
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              minimal: minimal
              low: low
              medium: medium
              high: high
              xhigh: xhigh
              max: max
{/each}- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: orch
    model: {model:json}
- id: acp
  config:
    provider: orch
    model: {model:json}
# Orch's environment confines the program, not its own sandbox, which cannot start inside a container.
- id: sandbox-policy
  config:
    mode: danger-full-access
    workspaceRoot: {cwd:json}
- id: approval
  config:
    policy: {approval.policy:json}
- id: permission
  config:
    presets:
      orch-ask:
        sandbox: danger-full-access
        approval: ask
      orch-bypass:
        sandbox: danger-full-access
        approval: never
    defaultPreset: {approval.preset:json}

# Orch's plugin for dsh, loaded by its absolute path. It adds what the protocol does not carry (live text, steering,
# questions, a plan to review, approvals, token counts of every model call, compaction phases) and says which of
# these work in `_orch/hello`. The plugin takes over the program's standard streams when it is loaded, so the row of
# `acp` stays as the base patch has it. The ask tool is the one the plugin turns into questions for a person.
- insert:
    - id: orch-bridge
      name: {plugin:json}
      config:
        approvals:
          mode: {approval.plugin:json}
    - id: tool-ask-user
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

# The model's tools for the environment (commands and files) run in the environment: the plugin takes over the rows
# that hold their names and sends each call to Orch's executor. A row's config replaces the one before it, so the
# plugin's row is given again with everything it had.
- id: tool-bash
  disabled: true
- id: tool-fs
  disabled: true
- id: tool-fs-search
  disabled: true
- id: tool-jobs
  disabled: true
- id: tool-working-directory
  disabled: true
- id: orch-bridge
  config:
    approvals:
      mode: {approval.plugin:json}
    backends:
      enabled: true
